summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on troubleshooting an issue where a facility, categorized as 'rail', was not being correctly pulled into analytics using a specific SQL query. Initial checks suggested potential data refresh delays in the system (CH). However, after further investigation by [me], the root cause was identified as a limitation related to string length within the ODBC or JDBC driver when handling asset comments for that specific asset.
[me] committed to fixing this issue, estimating it would take one to two hours. The process concluded with the fix being implemented.
decisions: The anomaly calculation granularity was confirmed to be by day.
A fix was applied to handle long string comments for facility data extraction.
